title: AgriInsights UK sustainability factors
gwp_basis: AR5 GWP100 (CH4 28, N2O 265) unless an entry says otherwise
about: factors-uk.json (191 entries, compiled 2026-11-10) plus the mock-up v50-v53 factors with FIGURES-CHECK-NOV-2026 corrections. status: confirmed (status_detail verified) or estimate (status_detail secondary / unverified / estimate). Phase 4 (-436-sus4, 15 Nov 2026): adds the N2O method switch (methods.n2o, B4), three IPCC 2019 manure-storage factors and two lime products. Additive: no earlier value changed. -439-sus6 (15 Nov 2026): no mock ids; UK inventory enteric factors (NID 2026 Annex A 5.1.8) and EF1 equations; IPCC 2019 storage losses and methane by system; dairy VS 8.4; urea manufacture 1.909; crop-available N moved to the law table; housing defaults (RESEARCH-DECISIONS F).
